guarantees.claim: err_code_e assigns 8-bit constant values to named error codes: ErrNone=00, ErrKeyNotValid=01, ErrSwPushedMsgFifo=02, ErrSwIssuedCmdInAppActive=03, ErrWaitTimerExpired=04, ErrIncorrectEntropyMode=05, ErrUnexpectedModeStrength=06, ErrIncorrectFunctionName=07, ErrSwCmdSequence=08, ErrSwHashingWithoutEntropyReady=09, ErrFatalError=C1, ErrPackerIntegrity=C2, ErrMsgFifoIntegrity=C3.
parameter ErrInfoW is assigned the constant value 24.
rsp_digest_t is a packed struct with fields digest_share0 and digest_share1, each of width AppDigestW, laid out contiguously.
err_t is a packed struct with fields valid (1 bit), code (8 bits), info (24 bits), totaling 33 bits.

assumptions.claim: Parameter AppDigestW is defined externally and is a positive integer used to size the rsp_digest_t shares.
assumptions.cond: when rsp_digest_t is instantiated or used as a type
assumptions.risk: If AppDigestW is undefined or zero, compilation fails; a mismatch with external digest width can cause silent truncation or extension of digest shares, breaking masked value assumptions.

uncertain_points.claim: err_code_e enumeration leaves the range 0x0A–0xC0 undefined; an err_code_e signal can legally hold any of these values because the base type is 8‑bit logic.
uncertain_points.cond: if a hardware or software bug writes an undefined code into an err_code_e variable
uncertain_points.risk: downstream error logic may not handle the undefined code, potentially missing an alarm, mis‑routing error info, or suppressing a fatal escalation.
